review_candidates.title: HR Country & Zone Manager BeNeLux
review_candidates.description: Unlock Your Potential at Eaton: Where Diversity Drives Innovation. No matter where you come from, your aspirations matter to us. We believe in the power of different perspectives, experiences, and backgrounds to ignite innovation and drive success. We're in the business of empowering people, and that includes you. Your journey here is not just about a job; it's about a shared vision for a brighter, more sustainable future. The HR Zone Leader BeNeLux provides end-to-end HR leadership across all Eaton entities within the zone, ensuring a consistent, compliant, and high-quality employee experience aligned with the "One HR" operating model. The role supports approximately 700 employees across five locations in three countries, with around 70% of the workforce based at the manufacturing facility in Hengelo. As the most senior HR leader in the region, this role translates talent priorities across multiple Eaton businesses into measurable people and business outcomes. The incumbent strengthens governance and labor relations while driving simplification, standardization, and continuous improvement across HR service delivery. The role reports at regional level and partners closely with HR Services (Budapest), Senior HR Business Partners, and HR Centers of Excellence to deploy enterprise-wide HR programs and deliver a seamless One Eaton employee experience. The role is responsible for simplifying and standardizing HR policies, practices, and processes while ensuring compliance with Dutch, Belgian, and Luxembourgish employment legislation. Location: Hengelo, The Netherlands Key Focus Areas HR Leadership Across the Employee Lifecycle Ensure strong execution and consistent delivery across the HR lifecycle, with clear delineation between local accountability and Center of Excellence (CoE) ownership. Talent Acquisition Lead local hiring execution and delivery against business workforce requirements. Partner with CoEs on talent acquisition strategy, employer branding, and workforce planning. Total Rewards Own the local execution, communication, and compliance of compensation and benefits programs. Ensure the consistent application of global compensation and benefits frameworks. Provide market intelligence and benchmarking insights to CoEs. Oversee local benefits administration and vendor relationships. Learning & Development Ensure the effective deployment, communication, and adoption of enterprise learning and development programs. Support the identification of capability gaps and development priorities across the zone. Facilitate local learning initiatives where required, while leveraging globally designed programs. Employee Experience & Engagement Drive culture, engagement, and wellbeing initiatives across all countries within the BeNeLux zone. Ensure effective communication channels and employee listening mechanisms. Translate employee feedback and insights into measurable actions and continuous improvements. HR Operations (Payroll, Time & Attendance, Employee Data Management) Ensure accurate, compliant, and efficient HR operations across the zone. Partner with HR Services to deliver a high-quality employee and manager experience. Monitor service delivery KPIs and drive continuous operational improvement. Simplification, Standardization & Digitalization Drive harmonization of HR processes in alignment with global standards and best practices. Promote the adoption of shared-service models and digital HR solutions. Lead continuous improvement initiatives across the zone. Simplify legacy processes and enhance operational efficiency. Change Leadership & Culture Lead and support the successful implementation of business transformation and organizational change initiatives across the zone. Act as an integral member of change management teams to ensure the compliant and effective delivery of business-led change programs. Lead by example in embedding the Eaton Culture Model by thinking big, acting boldly, and winning together. Foster a culture of innovation, accountability, inclusion, and collaboration while aligning people strategies with business objectives. Support leaders in navigating change and enhancing leadership effectiveness. Champion inclusion, collaboration, and employee wellbeing. Country Representation & Employer Branding Represent Eaton externally on HR-related matters with key stakeholders, industry associations, and employment partners. Support employer branding and talent positioning across the BeNeLux market. Act as a visible ambassador for the One Eaton mindset across the organization. Qualifications & Experience Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field. A Master's degree in Human Resources or a related discipline is preferred. 10+ years of progressive HR experience within multinational organizations, including significant leadership experience in a matrix environment. Experience in a manufacturing or industrial environment is preferred. Strong Employee Relations (ER) and Labor Relations (LR) experience, with in-depth knowledge of Dutch employment law, including Works Council (WOR) consultations, collective dismissal processes, social plans, reintegration, and CAO frameworks. Working knowledge of Belgian and Luxembourgish labor legislation is preferred. Proven experience in HR operations and service delivery within a shared-services environment. Demonstrated success in leading HR initiatives across multiple sites, countries, and legal entities within a matrix organization. Experience developing and executing HR strategies across the full employee and business lifecycle. Strong track record in employee engagement, organizational culture, and change management. Proven ability to drive outcomes and influence stakeholders within a matrix organization without direct authority. Credible and resilient partner to unions, works councils, and senior business leaders. Excellent communication skills, with the ability to engage effectively with shop-floor employees, commercial teams, and executive leaders. Collaborative and culturally aware, with experience working across the Netherlands, Belgium, and Luxembourg. Hands-on, pragmatic, and proactive, with a strong sense of ownership and accountability. Continuous improvement mindset with strong project and time management capabilities. Demonstrates sound judgment, discretion, and the highest standards of integrity. Fluent in Dutch and English. What We Offer Competitive compensation and benefits package Challenging projects in dynamic collaborative team Flexible working solutions We make your aspirations matter – Eaton encourages internal promotion, whenever possible We make your growth matter - We invest in our employees for the long term – not just with salary and benefits, but with ongoing learning and development opportunities made available through Eaton University We make your contributions matter - reliability, safety, efficiency, and sustainability are at the core of our dedication to improving people’s lives and the environment through power management technologies. We make your wellbeing matter – We put your health and safety first. Wellness at Eaton is more than a program, it’s about changing the environment by offering the right tools to help empower employees to make that happen. All positions may require participation in video and in-person interviews as part of the hiring process. All candidates will be evaluated based on job-related competencies, and all candidates’ privacy rights and data security will be protected in accordance with applicable laws. We are committed to ensuring equal employment opportunities for job applicants and employees. Our recruitment processes use balanced selection criteria and avoid unlawful discrimination against applicants on the basis of their age, colour, disability, marital status, national origin, gender, gender identity, genetic information, race or racial origin, religion, sexual orientation or any other status protected or required by law.

review_candidates.title: Field Project Coordinator
review_candidates.description: Job Position:  Field Project Coordinator Location:  One position per state. Andhra Pradesh (Prakasam, Guntur, Palnadu districts) | Karnataka (South Bengaluru, Mysuru, Hassan districts) Openings:  Two (1 per state) Reporting to:  Project Manager, Head Office Salary:  Up to 5.4 INR LPA Duration:  24 months (November 2026 to October 2028) Applicants must be fluent in the native language of the state for which they are applying. Preference will be given to candidates with prior experience in rural livelihoods and SHG/VO ecosystems). About the Organisation National Skills Foundation of India (NSFI) is a 15-year-old not-for-profit organisation focused on skill building and the development of vocational opportunities for India's large workforce. NSFI works towards enabling sustainable livelihoods through training of unskilled and semi-skilled workers, rural youth, farmers, and women entrepreneurs, and through action research in agriculture supply chains, markets, and skills. NSFI works with national and international agencies in the public sector and civil society domains. About Project Urjita Project Urjita is a rural entrepreneurship development programme implemented by NSFI across Andhra Pradesh and Karnataka over 24 months (November 2026 to October 2028). The programme covers 6 districts (3 per state), 420 villages, and targets 4,000 Rural Entrepreneurs, comprising rural youth and entrepreneurs. Andhra Pradesh districts: Prakasam, Guntur, and Palnadu. Karnataka districts: South Bengaluru, Mysuru, and Hassan. Business Orientation in Andhra Pradesh runs January to May 2027; Karnataka follows February to July 2027. Mentoring and business services continue through October 2028. Position Summary The Field Project Coordinator is a state-level role responsible for planning, implementation, coordination, and monitoring of Project Urjita across the assigned state. The Field Project Coordinator directly supervises 6 Field Facilitators, who in turn support 30 Udyami Preraks across 3 districts and 210 villages. The role requires strong field presence, operational discipline, and the ability to work with SHGs, Village Organisations, district administration, SRLMs, and community stakeholders. The Field Project Coordinator is responsible for ensuring that programme targets, including entrepreneur onboarding, business services delivery, enterprise formation, and income generation, are achieved in line with project timelines and donor requirements. Key Responsibilities A. Field Planning and Implementation •       Lead state-level planning and execution of all project activities across 3 districts and 210 villages, in line with the programme timeline and milestone plan. •       Oversee staggered onboarding of Rural Entrepreneurs as per the approved state schedule, ensuring Business Orientation batches are conducted on time and to standard. •       Coordinate and monitor the SHG and Village Organisation mapping process, which forms the basis for entrepreneur identification and enrolment. •       Facilitate site inspection, Incubation and Acceleration Centre set-up, and operationalization in coordination with the project management team. B. Field Team Leadership •       Supervise and guide 6 Field Facilitators, ensuring clear task allocation, regular performance review, and field support. •       Support Field Facilitators in managing their Udyami Preraks, including orientation, activity tracking, and coordination of honorarium disbursement. •       Conduct regular field visits across districts to monitor quality of delivery and address operational challenges. C. Programme Delivery •       Ensure quality delivery of the Prerak and Field Facilitator training •       Oversee Business Orientation delivery across state •       Coordinate and monitor quarterly Need Assessments. •       Facilitate the district Incubation and Acceleration Centres for the programme's entrepreneur cohort. •       Support delivery of expert handholding services. D. Stakeholder Management •       Build and maintain working relationships with the state SRLM (SERP in AP and KSRLPS in Karnataka), district administration (DRDA), Village Organisation leaders, NGO partners, and market linkage agencies. •       Represent the project in state and district-level meetings, inception events, stakeholder consultations, and field visits. •       Support MoU execution and coordination with state and district-level institutions. E. MIS, Reporting, and Quality Assurance •       Maintain and oversee the project MIS, ensuring accurate and timely recording of beneficiary data, training records, need assessment cycles. •       Prepare and submit regular progress reports (weekly and monthly) to the Head Office, covering achievements, challenges, risks, and corrective actions. •       Coordinate with the MIS Manager at Head Office and support platform operationalization from February 2027. •       Ensure adherence to project quality standards, NSFI norms, and donor guidelines across all field activities. •       Support baseline data collection and coordinate state-level inputs for the endline impact evaluation at project close. F. Resource and Centre Management •       Oversee effective use of project resources, including Centre assets, IT equipment, training materials, and budgets, across the state. •       Ensure the Incubation and Acceleration Centres are functional, maintained, and serve as effective hubs for entrepreneur. •       Undertake any additional responsibilities as assigned by the reporting manager. Qualifications and Experience •       Graduate or Postgraduate in Social Work, Rural Management, Rural Development, Agriculture, or a related field. •       Minimum 3 to 5 years of experience in rural livelihoods promotion, SHG or VO ecosystem strengthening, enterprise development, or related programmes, preferably in Andhra Pradesh or Karnataka. •       Demonstrated ability to lead a field team and manage implementation across multiple districts. •       Familiarity with state SRLM structures (SERP or KSRLPS) and district administration systems is an advantage. •       Proficient in MS Office and comfortable with MIS platforms and basic digital tools. •       Fluency in Telugu (for the AP position) or Kannada (for the Karnataka position) is essential. Working knowledge of English, including documentation, is required. Hindi is an advantage. •       Willingness to travel regularly within the state across 3 districts and approximately 70 villages per district. Expected Personality Traits •       Proactive and self-initiating; takes ownership of field operations without waiting for direction. •       High energy and reliability; capable of managing time-bound activities and milestones across a large geography. •       Strong interpersonal skills; able to work with a field team, build community trust, and engage with government and institutional stakeholders. •       Willing to learn and use digital tools, the project MIS platform, and the programme's phygital delivery model. •       Detail-oriented and accountable; takes responsibility for data quality, reporting accuracy, and outcome tracking. How to Apply Apply within 7 days of the date of publication of this advertisement. Submit a single Word-formatted document consisting of a cover letter and resume (with salary history if currently employed, applicable notice period, permanent and present address, and willingness to relocate to the state of posting) to: nsfiresumes@gmail.com Subject line: "Application for: Field Project Coordinator, Urjita (AP / Karnataka)" (please specify state). Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

review_candidates.title: Field Electrical Engineer
review_candidates.description: Field Electrical Engineer (Remote) - This position is full time remote based in California. NV5 owner representatives act as a dedicated advocate, alleviating project complexities and mitigating risks effectively. Utilizing the latest project controls and project management software, NV5 owner representatives plan and monitor project performance, identifying deviations from the plan and implementing corrective actions in a timely, cost-effective manner. Our expertise in strategic planning, cost estimation, project controls, and transition management ensures on-time, within-budget delivery to the highest quality standards. Whether it’s, facilitating site assessments, or coordinating facility shutdowns, owners can confidently trust our team to achieve project goals while experiencing peace of mind. As our Field Electrical Engineer , you will serve as an owner’s representative providing field inspections, construction quality assurance, oversight of electrical testing and commissioning activities at multiple sites during various phases of construction. Tasks include completion of checklists, adherence to established processes, identification of code compliance issues and common deficiencies, escalation of energization blockers and documenting as punch list items. Electrical systems are varied but include commercial electric vehicle charging infrastructure and commercial facility power upgrades. You will actively participate in internal weekly program syncs and work closely with the Project Managers to ensure necessary field documentation and checklists are completed. During weekly syncs all team members proactively participate to ensure client satisfaction and identify program efficiencies, review lessons learned and align on upcoming schedule for the week. The successful candidate will work virtually when not travelling to project sites. Responsibilities Other responsibilities include: Convey overall project status to clients by means of discussions, presentations, and project reports. Manage assigned site schedule, travel, communication with Client and onsite representatives and project budgets. Ability to engage with multiple stakeholder groups while onsite. Responsible for the effective management of own time and effort. Frequent travel within the United States to attend site walks and Owners Rep onsite services at commercial customer sites (Approximately 50-75% travel). Inspect, oversee NETA vendor testing, and onsite verification of installed low, medium (480 Volt) and potentially high voltage electrical systems. Assess power transformer testing results - Doble, TTR, Insulation Resistance, etc. Oversee NETA vendor testing of both electro-mechanical and solid-state relays. Verify acceptable cable testing results provided by NETA vendor - Tan Delta, Power Factor, VLF, DC Hipot. Identify and create punch list of deficiencies observed while onsite. Oversee onsite activities to ensure compliance with Client processes and procedures. Automatic transfer switch troubleshooting oversight. Low, Medium and High voltage switchgear and circuit breaker experience. Relay calibration and power metering knowledge. Able to attend customer sites in a timely manner. Qualifications We are seeking the following experience & qualifications: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering or related technical field. 5+ years of field electrical maintenance experience within engineering, procurement, and construction (EPC) of commercial projects or similar. Ability to identify onsite deficiencies and energization blockers. Can recommend resolution and identify root cause. Experience working with NETA qualified testing vendors, ability to assess pass/fail of test results. Proficient with Medium Voltage infrastructure including functional testing of relays. Ability to work in small teams and coordinate onsite activities during outages (for preventative maintenance or power upgrades). Experience developing and conveying findings to public or private entities. Proficiency with Microsoft programs including Outlook, Teams, Excel, Word, Adobe / Bluebeam and Smartsheet. Must have excellent communication skills. The salary range for this position is $100,000 - $135,000 per year, depending on experience and qualifications. Additional compensation may include restricted stock units, performance-based bonuses, and a comprehensive benefits package covering medical, dental, PTO, 401(k), unlimited FTO (Flexible Time Off) and professional development opportunities. NV5 provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, amnesty, or status as a covered veteran in accordance with applicable federal, state and local laws. NV5 complies with applicable state and local laws governing non-discrimination in employment in every location in which the company has facilities. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including, but not limited to, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training. Recruitment & Staffing Agencies : NV5 Inc does not accept unsolicited resumes from any source other than passive & active candidates and employee referrals. The submission of unsolicited resumes by recruitment or staffing agencies to NV5 or its employees is strictly prohibited unless contacted directly by NV5's internal Talent Acquisition team seeking 3rd party sourcing assistance. Any resume submitted by an agency in the absence of a signed agreement and given permission to represent NV5 to candidates on a particular search, NV5 will not owe any referral or other fees with respect to the unsolicited submission. #INDHP

review_candidates.title: Expresión de Interés: Especialista Senior Control de Costos
review_candidates.description: Job Description GHD busca profesional senior especializado en control de costos para proyecto futuro. El rol estará enfocado en estructurar, mantener, analizar y desafiar técnicamente la información económica de los proyectos o programas asignados. Deberá asegurar bases de costo confiables, forecast trazable, control de compromisos y cambios, análisis oportuno de desviaciones y recomendaciones para la toma de decisiones. El rol se desarrolla en modalidad presencial en faena, bajo turno administrativo 4x3, con asistencia presencial de lunes a jueves. Principales responsabilidades Definir y mantener la metodología y estructura de control de costos, incluyendo WBS/CBS, cuentas de control, presupuesto, paquetes de trabajo y correspondencia con contratos, órdenes de compra y centros de costo. Establecer, revisar y custodiar la línea base aprobada, verificando su trazabilidad con alcance, cantidades, estimación, programa y autorizaciones, y asegurando que toda modificación se gestione mediante control formal de cambios. Preparar y actualizar el forecast, integrando costos reales, compromisos, provisiones, trabajo remanente, tendencias, cambios, riesgos, oportunidades y contingencias, determinando ETC, EAC y VAC. Verificar y desafiar la consistencia entre alcance, cantidades, avance físico, productividad, valorizaciones, contratos, compromisos, gastos, programa, flujo de caja y forecast. Controlar económicamente contratos y órdenes de compra, incluyendo adjudicaciones, modificaciones, estados de pago, provisiones, saldos, reclamos, exposición contractual y cierre; conciliar la información con SAP y los registros del proyecto. Responsabilidad: Administrar el registro integrado de tendencias y cambios con impacto en costo, diferenciando riesgos, desviaciones, cambios propuestos y aprobados, uso de contingencia y rebaseline; evaluar impactos y recomendar tratamiento y escalamiento. Resultado esperado: Trazabilidad y tratamiento oportuno de impactos potenciales y aprobados. Revisar estimaciones y bases de estimación, verificando alcance, cantidades, precios, productividad, supuestos, inclusiones, exclusiones, escalación, contingencia, riesgos, rango y nivel de confianza; reconciliar versiones sucesivas. Preparar proyecciones de flujo de caja y ejecución presupuestaria mensual y anual, diferenciando desviaciones de oportunidad de desembolso respecto de variaciones del costo final y evaluando escenarios de reprogramación. Preparar y presentar análisis de costos de proyectos, programas y cartera, con desempeño, EAC, flujo de caja, contingencia, cambios, riesgos, exposiciones, decisiones requeridas y recomendación. Ejercer liderazgo técnico sobre la disciplina de costos asignada, aplicar controles de calidad, proponer mejoras y automatización, mantener lecciones aprendidas y liderar el cierre económico de proyectos y contratos. Requisitos Título profesional de Ingeniería Civil Industrial, Ingeniería Civil, Ingeniería en Construcción, Construcción Civil, Ingeniería Comercial u otra especialidad afín, con experiencia demostrable en control de costos de proyectos Mínimo 10 años de experiencia profesional, con al menos 7 años en Project Controls y control de costos de proyectos de inversión, preferentemente en minería o industrias intensivas en capital. Experiencia comprobable liderando el control de costos de proyectos o programas de mediana o alta complejidad, desde estimación y línea base hasta cierre económico. Dominio avanzado de presupuesto, baseline, costos reales, compromisos, provisiones, flujo de caja, ETC, EAC y VAC. Dominio de WBS/CBS, cuentas de control e integración entre alcance, cantidades, CAPEX, contratos, avance físico y programa. Experiencia en control económico de contratos, estados de pago, cambios, provisiones, reclamos, cierre contractual y conciliación con ERP. Manejo avanzado de Microsoft Excel y Power BI.Capacidad para revisar modelos de costo, detectar inconsistencias, desarrollar escenarios y emitir recomendaciones técnicas independientes. Inglés intermedio-avanzado y licencia de conducir clase B. Como organización multicultural, fomentamos los logros individuales y reconocemos la fortaleza de una fuerza laboral diversa. En GHD nos regimos por la Ley de Inclusión Laboral (Ley N° 21.015). Brindamos igualdad de oportunidades a todos los empleados y solicitantes calificados sin distinción de raza, credo, religión, origen nacional, ciudadanía, color, sexo, orientación sexual, identidad de género, edad, discapacidad o estado civil.
